panels.description: Database overall CPU utilization aggregated across selected servers

targets.expr: (sum by() (spanner_cpu_utilization_by_priority_and_category{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer", database=~"$Database"}) * 100) / ignoring(database) group_left() sum(spanner_available_milligcu{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"})

panels.title: CPU Utilization Overview

panels.description: Utilization of CPU in the selected database, grouped by User/System tasks and priority. The utilization is aggregated across the selected servers.

targets.expr: (sum by(priority, is_system) (spanner_cpu_utilization_by_priority_and_category{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer", database=~"$Database"}) * 100) / ignoring(priority, is_system) group_left() sum(spanner_available_milligcu{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"})

panels.title: CPU utilization by user/system

panels.description: Utilization of CPU grouped by operation type for the selected database aggregated across the selected servers.

targets.expr: (sum by(category) (spanner_cpu_utilization_by_priority_and_category{job="spanner", database=~"$Database", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"}) * 100) / ignoring(category) group_left() sum(spanner_available_milligcu{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"})

panels.title: CPU Utilization By Operation Type

panels.description: Utilization of CPU grouped by operation type and filtered by high priority for the selected database aggregated across the selected servers.

targets.expr: (sum by(category) (spanner_cpu_utilization_by_priority_and_category{job="spanner", priority="high", database=~"$Database", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"}) * 100) / ignoring(category) group_left() sum(spanner_available_milligcu{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"})

panels.title: CPU Utilization By Operation Type - High Priority

panels.description: Utilization of CPU grouped by operation type and filtered by medium priority for the selected database aggregated across the selected servers.

targets.expr: (sum by(category) (spanner_cpu_utilization_by_priority_and_category{job="spanner", priority="medium", database=~"$Database", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"}) * 100) / ignoring(category) group_left() sum(spanner_available_milligcu{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"})

panels.title: CPU Utilization By Operation Type - Medium Priority

panels.description: Utilization of CPU grouped by operation type and filtered by low priority for the selected database aggregated across the selected servers.

targets.expr: (sum by(category) (spanner_cpu_utilization_by_priority_and_category{job="spanner", priority="low", database=~"$Database", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"}) * 100) / ignoring(category) group_left() sum(spanner_available_milligcu{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer"})

panels.title: CPU Utilization By Operation Type - Low Priority

panels.description: P50 latency within a selected database, grouped by API methods across the selected servers

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, method) (delta(spanner_api_request_latencies_bucket{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer", database=~"$Database"}[1m]))), "method", "${1}", "method", ".*/(.*)")

panels.description: P90 latency within a selected database, grouped by API methods across the selected servers

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by(le, method) (delta(spanner_api_request_latencies_bucket{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer", database=~"$Database"}[1m]))), "method", "${1}", "method", ".*/(.*)")

panels.description: P99 latency within a selected database, grouped by API methods across the selected servers

targets.expr: label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, method) (delta(spanner_api_request_latencies_bucket{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer", database=~"$Database"}[1m]))), "method", "$1", "method", ".*/(.*)")

panels.description: P50 request latency within a selected database, grouped by transaction type and leader involvement across the selected servers

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le, transaction_type, is_leader_involved) (delta(spanner_api_request_latencies_bucket{job="spanner", spanner_server=~"$SpannerServer", database=~"$Database", transaction_type!="NONE"}[1m])))

panels.description:
Non replicated physical bytes used by each database.
This metric is coming from leader tablet of each group, the actual replicated physical bytes across all tablets of a  group might be higher/lower depending upon state of compactions on each tablet but this metric gives an approximate idea of how much non replicated physical storage is being used by each database.
